grace_v1.note: Server-side only. Never browser-controllable. Changing model or disable_thinking requires a NEW model-evaluation decision and a bump here; grace-model-lock-verify.mjs fails on drift.

grace_policy_candidate.release_authority: Thomas (separate release decision; merge is not approval)
grace_policy_candidate.note: A candidate is source that differs from grace_v1.policy_version. It may exist on main but must NOT be deployed by grace-lock / grace-eval / grace-compare (they run grace-model-lock-verify.mjs --require-approved-policy). Promotion = new evaluation evidence + Thomas's release decision, then grace_v1.policy_version and its evidence are updated in one reviewable change and this block is removed. grace_v1 evidence above qualifies grace-policy-1.2.0 only.
